protocol: Pre-registered before the first SPORE state ingest or detector call on this clip: this probe file, its registration test and the run configuration (surface head on, fixed-label veto off) are committed together. Labels come from visual inspection of a 1 fps contact sheet plus the full frame at 40 s; the query detector was not consulted. The window is a living-room tidying scene with a large blue-and-cream area rug, a round coffee table with a dark tray and a blue book, a gray sofa, and a tan leather armchair; a gray blanket is on the sofa, never on the floor. A 'no' label means the object is not visible anywhere in the window. This is a second held-out test of the same .35 soft-object floor rule used on play_3, on a different living room and a different rug.

questions.query: Is there a rug on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Large blue/cream patterned area rug covers the living-room floor.

questions.query: Is there a sofa on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Gray sofa on the right, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a chair on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Tan leather armchair on the left, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a book on the table?
questions.human_evidence: Dark blue book on the round coffee table at 40 s.

questions.query: Is there a cup on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No cup or glass anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a bottle on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No bottle anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a laptop on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No laptop anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a plate on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No plate anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a hammer on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No hammer anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is the rug still on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: The area rug stays on the floor for the whole window.

questions.query: Is the sofa still on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: The sofa does not leave the seating area.
The rug is static for the whole window.
The sofa is static in the seating area.
